items.source: When this flag is set to true messages within the same session will be sent to the "clientInboundChannel" one at a time in order to preserve the order in which they were received.
items.translation: 当此标志设置为 `true` 时，同一会话中的消息将按接收顺序逐个发送到 `"clientInboundChannel"`，以保留其接收顺序。

items.source: By default messages sent to the "clientInboundChannel" may be handled in parallel and not in the same order as they were received because the channel is backed by a ThreadPoolExecutor that in turn does not guarantee processing in order.
items.translation: 默认情况下，发送到 `"clientInboundChannel"` 的消息可能会并行处理，且处理顺序与接收顺序不一致，因为该通道由 `ThreadPoolExecutor` 支持，而后者不保证按序处理。

items.source: The default value is 1.
items.translation: 默认值为 1。
